channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran touts military response as US maintains blockade, hits tankers
item.description: Tehran says time for proportionate retaliation is over after a US strike on Iranian tankers inside the blockade line.

item.title: How significant are the Yemeni government’s military gains against Houthis?
item.description: Government forces make gains as fighting escalates, raising fears of a return to full-scale war.

item.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
item.description: The US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers, while Iran says it targeted three US-linked ships.

item.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
item.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

item.title: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
item.description: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.
